title: Battle of Ösel Island
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ösel Island", at revision 1377870012, opens: "The Battle of Ösel Island took place on 4 June 1719 (N.S.), during the Great Northern War. It was fought near the island of Saaremaa (Ösel)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q645723, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1719 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
